title: Human Skull, Bones Found In Percolation Pit Of Apartment In Bengaluru
text:
Human Skull, Bones Found In Percolation Pit Of Apartment In Bengaluru
Human skeletal remains were found in a percolation pit at Credence Flora apartment complex in Bengaluru. The discovery was made during a cleanup.
Residents of the Credence Flora apartment complex in Bengaluru’s Mico Layout were shocked to discover a human skull and bones in one of the percolation pits during cleaning on June 16.
A case of unnatural death has been registered by the Begur police based on the complaint by Skariya John, president of the resident welfare association (RWA). The skull and bones have been sent for forensic analysis.

Police officials said that the discovery was made on Monday at one of the 16 pits next to the parking lot while a cleanup was underway. They are awaiting a report from the experts, which could provide more details, including the age of the deceased.
Human skeletal remains were discovered in a rainwater harvesting chamber at the Credence Flora apartment complex in Bengaluru’s Mico Layout. The chamber, which was clogged with silt and debris, typically held water during rainfall.
John, in his complaint, said that the RWA had given a contract to clean up 16 percolation pits in the apartment.
While cleaning one of the pits, the workers found human remains. They alerted John, who informed the police.
“Going by the recovery of the skull, it looks like the incident might have happened many years ago. It was very surprising how the RWA or the residents did not get to know about it," a police officer said.
Further investigation into the case is underway.
